summary: The audit checks 20 letter-graded units of BIOE courses at or above the 200 level, at least 10 of them in BIOE itself. Cognate courses (at most ten units) have no list, so you move them in. You check the 3.25 GPA and the minor advisor from the Bioengineering faculty on your reading committee by hand; courses used for the minor may not also count toward a master's degree.

program.why: Grading: "All courses listed to fulfill the 20-unit requirement must be taken for a letter grade."

totals.label: 10 units in Bioengineering (at most ten in cognate courses)
totals.why: "The PhD minor program must include at least 20 units of coursework in Stanford Bioengineering or Bioengineering cognate courses at or above the 200 level. Of these 20 units, no more than ten can be in cognate courses."
